What makes this scene so painful is seeing who Lee used to be before grief turned him into a completely different person. The laughter, the chaos, the warmth… it all feels so normal, and that’s exactly why it hurts. Manchester by sea is honestly one of the most emotionally devastating films I’ve ever seen that I genuinely don’t think I can watch again.

Casey Affleck’s performance as Lee Chandler is a masterclass in internalised pain. Interestingly, the role was originally intended for Matt Damon (who also produced the film), but he stepped aside for Affleck, recognizing he was the right fit for Lee's hollowed-out exterior.
